content.short: Greens is a farming game where players use land, soil conditions, seeds, harvesting, and market activity.
content.description: Greens is built around virtual land and farming strategy. Players choose land for planting, account for temperature, humidity, acidity, soil type, and humus, then plant seeds, harvest crops, and sell production to other players. You should check the real temperature, humidity, acidity, and soil type of these lands. We can plant seeds and get the harvest to sell to other players. The product surface includes lands, temperature, humidity, and ph level. Users approach Greens as a game first, while blockchain features support the surrounding economy, rewards, ownership, or community layer.
